description: Fill-in-the-blank story fun — pick from built-in Mad Libs templates, enter silly words, and read your hilarious story.

faqs.a: 5 complete story templates: a space adventure, a haunted house, a cooking disaster, a sports final and a pirate tale.
Each blank tells you the word type needed (noun, verb, adjective…), so no grammar knowledge is required.
faqs.q: Do I need to know grammar?

faqs.a: Yes — copy your finished story to share it anywhere.

howto: Fill in each blank with a silly word.
Read it aloud and copy it to share.
title: Mad Libs Generator
